title: Three protein extraction methods for mass spectrometry proteomics of fresh frozen mouse tissue
author: Zheng Ser
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-1036/v1
materials: Pool eluted peptide solutions. Proceed with solid phase extraction using C18 macrospin columns (Nest Group) following manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Tissue Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh frozen mouse tissue for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Euthanize mice and dissect the necessary tissue.
Flash freeze tissue in liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C.
Weigh fresh frozen tissue on an analytical balance and note the wet weight.

steps.title: Protein Extraction Method 1 (SDS-FASP)
steps.instruction: Extract proteins using extraction buffer 1 and prepare for FASP purification.

substeps.instruction: Add 100μl of extraction buffer 1 to fresh frozen heart tissue in a 1.7ml Eppendorf tube.
Grind tissue vigorously with a motorized tissue grinder for 3 minutes.
Add another 100μl of extraction buffer 1 and repeat grinding for 3 minutes.
Add remaining extraction buffer (100μl per 5mg of tissue wet weight) and repeat grinding until no large chunks remain.
Transfer tissue suspension to a Covaris milliTUBE (max 1ml per tube).
Sonicate using Covaris Adaptive focused ultrasonicator: 5min total, 30s constant pulse (130W peak) with 30s pauses between pulses.
Centrifuge at 18,000g for 10min and transfer supernatant to a clean Eppendorf tube.
Quantify protein using Pierce BCA protein assay kit per manufacturer's instructions.
Dilute protein lysate by adding 500μl of urea buffer for every 10μl of lysate (target 100-200μg protein for downstream analysis).

steps.title: FASP Purification and Digestion
steps.instruction: Purify and digest proteins using Vivacon 500 filter units.

substeps.instruction: Load up to 500μl of diluted lysate (max 200μg protein total) onto a Vivacon 500 filter unit; centrifuge at 14,000g for 15min and discard flow-through.
Repeat loading/centrifugation for remaining lysate in 500μl volumes, using multiple units if total protein exceeds 200μg.
Wash by adding 200μl urea buffer, centrifuge at 14,000g for 15min, and discard flow-through; repeat once.
Add 100μl of 100mM DTT in urea buffer, incubate at room temperature for 20min, centrifuge at 14,000g for 15min, and discard flow-through.
Add 100μl of 100mM IAA in urea buffer, incubate at room temperature for 20min in the dark, centrifuge at 14,000g for 15min, and discard flow-through.
Wash by adding 200μl urea buffer, centrifuge at 14,000g for 15min, and discard flow-through.
Add 50μl of 0.1μg/μl trypsin (1:20 ratio) and 50mM ammonium bicarbonate solution to a final volume of 200μl.
Mix filter unit at 600rpm for 1min and incubate at 37°C for 14-18hr.
Transfer filter unit to a clean tube and centrifuge at 14,000g for 20min to elute peptides.
Add 100μl of 50mM ammonium bicarbonate solution and centrifuge at 14,000g for 20min to further elute peptides.

steps.title: Peptide Recovery and Storage
steps.instruction: Pool peptides and perform solid phase extraction.

substeps.instruction: Pool eluted peptide solutions and add formic acid to a final 1% v/v concentration.
Perform solid phase extraction using C18 macrospin columns (Nest Group) per manufacturer's instructions.
Concentrate purified peptides by vacuum centrifugation and store pellets at -20°C.

steps.title: Protein Extraction Method 2 (SDS-STrap)
steps.instruction: Extract proteins using extraction buffer 2 and prepare for S-Trap purification.

substeps.instruction: Add 100μl of extraction buffer 2 to fresh frozen heart tissue in a 1.7ml Eppendorf tube.
Grind vigorously with a motorized tissue grinder for 3 minutes.
Add another 100μl of extraction buffer 2 and repeat grinding for 3 minutes.
Add remaining extraction buffer (100μl per 5mg of tissue wet weight) and repeat grinding until no large chunks remain.
Transfer tissue suspension to a Covaris milliTUBE (max 1ml per tube).
Sonicate using Covaris Adaptive focused ultrasonicator: 6min total, 200 cycles per burst (175W peak) with 10% duty factor.
Heat suspension at 95°C for 1hr.
Repeat the sonication step.
Centrifuge at 18,000g for 10min and transfer supernatant to a clean Eppendorf tube.
Quantify protein using Pierce BCA protein assay kit; adjust concentration to 1μg/μl and take 100μl (100μg) for further steps.

steps.title: S-Trap Purification and Digestion
steps.instruction: Purify and digest proteins using S-Trap mini columns.

substeps.instruction: Add 11μl of 100mM DTT in extraction buffer 2 to lysate; incubate at 56°C for 1hr.
Cool to room temperature, add 12μl of 550mM IAA in extraction buffer 2, and incubate at room temperature for 30min in the dark.
Add 13μl of 100mM DTT in extraction buffer 2; incubate at 56°C for 30min.
Cool to room temperature and centrifuge at 100g for 2min; transfer supernatant to a clean Eppendorf tube.
Add 20μl 12% phosphoric acid and 2.8ml binding buffer to the lysate.
Load lysate mixture onto S-trap mini column in 400μl portions, centrifuging at 4,000g for 30s and discarding flow-through after each portion.
Wash column three times by adding 400μl binding buffer and centrifuging at 4,000g for 30s.
Transfer spin column to a fresh 2ml tube.
Add trypsin (1:20 w/w concentration) in 125μl 50mM ammonium bicarbonate to the column.
Lightly centrifuge to wet the column, pipette flow-through back, remove bubbles, and incubate at 37°C for 18hr without shaking.
Elute peptides by adding 80μl 50mM ammonium bicarbonate and centrifuging at 1,000g for 30s.
Elute further by adding 80μl 80% acetonitrile with 0.2% formic acid and centrifuging at 1,000g for 30s; repeat once.
Centrifuge column at 4,000g for 30s to elute all remaining peptides.
Concentrate purified peptides by vacuum centrifugation and store pellets at -20°C.

steps.title: Protein Extraction Method 3 (GH-IS)
steps.instruction: Extract proteins using extraction buffer 3 and perform in-solution digestion.

substeps.instruction: Add 100μl of extraction buffer 3 to fresh frozen heart tissue in a 1.7ml Eppendorf tube.
Grind vigorously with a motorized tissue grinder for 3 minutes.
Add another 100μl of extraction buffer 3 and repeat grinding for 3 minutes.
Add remaining extraction buffer (100μl per 5mg of tissue wet weight) and repeat grinding until no large chunks remain.
Transfer tissue suspension to a Covaris milliTUBE (max 1ml per tube).
Sonicate using Covaris Adaptive focused ultrasonicator: 5min total, 30s constant pulse (130W peak) with 30s pauses between pulses.
Centrifuge at 18,000g for 10min and transfer supernatant to a clean Eppendorf tube.
Quantify protein using Pierce BCA protein assay kit; adjust concentration to 1μg/μl and take 100μl (100μg) for further steps.
Add 11μl of 100mM DTT in extraction buffer 2; incubate at 56°C for 1hr.
Cool to room temperature, add 12μl of 550mM IAA in extraction buffer 2, and incubate at room temperature for 30min in the dark.
Add 13μl of 100mM DTT in extraction buffer 2; incubate at 56°C for 30min.
Cool to room temperature, add 50μl of 0.1μg/μl trypsin (1:20 ratio), and dilute to a final volume of 1ml with 50mM ammonium bicarbonate.
Incubate at 37°C for 14-18hr.
Add formic acid to a final 1% v/v concentration.
Perform solid phase extraction using C18 macrospin columns (Nest Group) per manufacturer's instructions.
Concentrate purified peptides by vacuum centrifugation and store pellets at -20°C.

steps.title: Optional Peptide Pre-fractionation (SCX)
steps.instruction: Perform strong cation exchange (SCX) fractionation for increased protein coverage.

substeps.instruction: Set up SCX column (Protein Pak Hi-Res SP 7µm 4.6 x 100mm, Waters) on Alliance HPLC system: flow rate 0.5 ml/min, temperature 30°C.
Solvent A: 0.1% formic acid in water; Solvent B: 1M potassium chloride in 5% acetonitrile and 0.1% formic acid in water.
Resuspend peptides in 0.1% formic acid in water to 1μg/μl concentration.
Inject 100μl of peptides using the gradient: 0-3 min (0% B); 3-83 min (0-35% B); 83-90 min (35-50% B); 90-91 min (50-100% B); 91-99 min (100% B); 99-100 min (100-0% B); 100-120 min (0% B).
Collect five fractions from 3 to 51min and a sixth fraction from 51 to 75min.
Perform solid phase extraction for each fraction using C18 macrospin columns (Nest Group).
Concentrate fractions by vacuum centrifugation and store pellets at -20°C.

steps.title: LC-MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze peptides using liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend peptides to 0.5 μg/μl in 0.1% formic acid in water.
Prepare Dionex 3000 Ultimate HPLC: Solvent A (0.1% formic acid in water), Solvent B (0.1% formic acid, 80% acetonitrile in water).
Load 2μl of peptides onto Acclaim PepMap C18 trap column at 3μl/min; use Easy-Spray HPLC column (75µm x 500mm) for reverse phase separation.
Set MS acquisition: Precursor ions 400-1500 m/z (60,000 resolution, AGC 3x10^6, max injection 54ms).
Select Top 20 precursor ions (exclude charge 1 and ≥5, isolation window 0.7 Th, 1.6x10^5 intensity threshold).
Record fragment ions 200-2000 m/z (30,000 resolution, AGC 2x10^5, max injection 50ms).

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Process raw mass spectra files using MaxQuant.

substeps.instruction: Analyze raw files using MaxQuant v1.6.0.16 against the mouse proteome from SwissProt (Nov 2018) and cRAP contaminants.
Parameters: Max 2 missed cleavages, min peptide length 7, fixed carbamidomethylation of cysteine, up to 3 variable modifications (methionine oxidation, asparagine/glutamine deamidation).
Set precursor mass tolerance to 10 ppm and 1% FDR for PSM and protein levels.
